name: Ray Casting with Slice-Based Sampling and Gradient Shading
definition: A ray casting technique that samples a 3D volume stored in a 2D texture atlas, computes surface normals via finite differences of sampled densities, and applies diffuse shading. It stops sampling when a high-density threshold is reached or the ray exits the bounding box.
summary: This direct volume rendering method uses a 2D texture atlas for storage and computes gradients via finite differences for diffuse shading, distinguishing itself from standard ray marching.
